name: Lunar-Reflection Wraith
journal_prompt: An incorporeal, tactile illusion manifested by lunar radiation refracting on the Great Bath's water, haunting lonely travelers.
appearance: An ethereal, faceless apparition made entirely of rippling silver light and the caustic patterns of moonlit water. It hovers a hand's breadth above the surface and mirrors, distorted, the silhouette of whoever looks into it.
